from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    seed = grid[0].index(2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in (seed - r, seed + r):
            if 0 <= c < n:
                out[r][c] = 2
        for c in range(n):
            if out[r][c] == 0 and (c - r - seed) % 4 == 0 and c + r >= seed + 2:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p=root/'task-c0bd55fe.py'
p.write_text(code)
ns={}
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),ns)
tf=ns['transform']
d1=[[0]*13];d1[0][6]=2
d2=[[0]*5];d2[0][2]=2
o1=tf(d1);o2=tf(d2)
print(o1)
print(o2)

answer=tf(test)
